context.content_translation:
车行经 Willingboro 北部地区将很困难，直到道路维修项目完成。
A. through
B. under
C. among
D. upon

items.question: Car travel ----- the northern part of Willingboro will be difficult until the road repair projects are completed.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“through”代入题干后为“Car travel through the northern part of Willingboro will be difficult until the road repair projects are completed.”。选择理由：该项同时满足句法结构、固定搭配和句意要求，其余选项至少有一项不符。正确答案：A（through）。
